examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Four measured facts at the default `medium` scale. The unit rides in `suffix` and the qualifier in `prefix`, so the figure itself stays the largest, highest-contrast thing in each cell. A band with no items renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: Every `size` value, one band under the other. Only the figure moves up the big-number scale — the caption stays at overline scale and the cell keeps its frame, so a denser section can drop to `small` and a page hero can reach for `large` without the band changing shape.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same content written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<Stats>` tag into a real `Stats`. Braced attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component.
